response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical breadth across languages and systems, and a clear track record of building scalable infrastructure and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading experimentation platforms, AI-driven growth systems, or enterprise-scale feature flagging and telemetry frameworks required for the Principal role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and distributed systems across multiple high-scale environments.
Proven ability to design and ship open-source infrastructure tools (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) with real-world adoption.
Strong technical leadership demonstrated through mentoring, workshops, and cross-team tooling contributions.
concerns: No clear evidence of building or owning experimentation, feature-flagging, or growth measurement platforms at scale.
Lacks documented experience with AI tools accelerating engineering velocity or bias/risk controls in experimentation.
Minimal emphasis on statistical analysis, telemetry foundations, or cross-team alignment around growth metrics.
